about: The sentences that the website (site/index.html) and the README say in the same words. When one of them changes here, change it in both: a test (src/lib/sharedFacts.test.ts) checks that each one is in both. The website is the short, pretty overview; the README goes deeper and is technical.

facts.text: Mimer keeps your notes as plain Markdown files, with tasks, meetings and an AI that runs on your own computer and only ever suggests.
Mimer does not phone home. There is nothing to sign up for.
The AI reads your notes only on your own machine. A cloud AI is possible, but only after you say yes, and never in a project you lock to local.
The AI never changes a note on its own. Every change is a proposal you review.
Open your vault in any other editor, any day. There is no database to export and no format to escape from.
Every change is saved in a built-in Git history. Bring back any version of a note, or a note you deleted.
Mimer is free and open source (AGPL-3.0).
They can be installed side by side, and your notes are plain files in both.
The first finished release. Calm, tested and updated less often, so you are not asked to update all the time.
The newest features, as they are built. It changes often.
Mimer never looks for updates by itself and sends nothing. Use Help → Check for new version… in the app to see if a newer version is out.
